name: io.github.Veniwol-Li-Lambd/lilambd-mcp
title: Lilambd Data for Agents
description: 170 data tools for agents: airports, hazards, markets, CVEs, Japan stats. x402 USDC or free samples.

environmentVariables.name: LILAMBD_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated product ids to expose (default: all 27 products, 172 tools)

environmentVariables.name: LILAMBD_DEFAULT_SAMPLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to default every call to the free 3-row preview

environmentVariables.name: LILAMBD_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Shell command that reads x402 payment requirements JSON on stdin and prints a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value

environmentVariables.name: LILAMBD_RAPIDAPI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: RapidAPI host for the key above
